args.palette_name: Mega Drive 3-bit RGB copper and teal shared sprite
args.description: ONE charming tiny copper hot-air balloon with a miniature woven basket, exactly 16 pixels wide by 24 pixels tall native pixel-art canvas, side view. Rounded red-copper balloon with a warm ivory glint and turquoise trim, two taut ropes and a readable small basket. Whole silhouette inside canvas with at least one transparent pixel of margin. Confident crisp single-pixel dark teal outline, deliberate connected pixel clusters, 2 to 3 shades per material, no antialiasing, no semitransparent pixels, no blur, no gradient fog, no text, no cast shadow, no ground. Design at the requested tiny pixel grid, not high-resolution art shrunk down.

args.palette_name: Mega Drive 3-bit RGB warm stone and jade garden
args.description: Native 320 by 160 pixel 16-bit sidescrolling game background: a peaceful elevated stone garden terrace, carved low balustrade, a small central fountain, symmetrical potted topiary and distant pale green hills beneath warm cream sky. Side-on orthographic game camera, no perspective floor stretching, no characters, no text, no UI. Elegant readable silhouettes, clean intentional single-pixel edges and connected clusters. Use repeated 8 by 8 architectural modules and broad quiet sky/floor areas so tiles can be reused. Muted jade foliage with warm sandstone highlights, luminous but restrained. Crisp authentic native-resolution pixel art, no antialiasing or blurred edges, no tiny noisy texture, no photographic detail, no painterly wash, no fake upscaled pixel blocks. All pixels on a one-pixel grid.

args.palette_name: Mega Drive 3-bit RGB deep navy and luminous teal cavern
args.description: Native 320 by 160 pixel 16-bit sidescrolling game background: a beautiful subterranean lantern grotto with an ancient small stone aqueduct crossing still turquoise water, a few tall angular teal crystals, dark violet-blue stalactites framing the top and one warm amber lantern as focal point. Side-on orthographic game camera, no perspective floor, no characters, no text, no UI. Clear stone silhouettes, reusable repeated 8 by 8 masonry modules, broad quiet dark areas and water. Crisp deliberate single-pixel edges and connected pixel clusters, controlled highlights, atmospheric without fog blur. No antialiasing, no semitransparency, no photographic texture, no fine dithering noise, no painterly smudges, no fake enlarged pixel blocks. All pixels on the native one-pixel grid.

style_image.usage_description: Use this exact hot-air balloon as the fixed design. Keep identical balloon silhouette, canvas placement, dimensions and palette. This is a second animation cel, not a new design.

args.description: Second animation cel of the reference hot air balloon, same exact 16 by 24 native-pixel transparent canvas and same fixed silhouette and size. Keep balloon and basket pixel position aligned. Change only a tiny 1-pixel warm sparkle on the brass trim and gentle rope/basket sway by one pixel. No resizing, no extra objects, no shadow, no text, no antialiasing, no translucent edge pixels. Crisp connected pixel clusters with the same dark teal outline and copper/ivory highlight.
